description: Bug investigation confirmed that `swarm-manager backlog list --kind execute` returns and renders every matching item by default, producing 1,358 human-output lines and a 393,423-byte JSON payload for 196 execute items in the current environment. The `backlog list` CLI has filters for kind/status/archived/scenario/json but no --limit or pagination flag, and `/api/v1/backlog` returns all items after filtering. Add an agent-safe bounded default or visible --limit/page controls, preserve an explicit full-output mode for operators, and include truncation metadata/markers in human and JSON output. Regression coverage should assert broad list calls stay bounded while full output remains available.
name: fix-swarm-manager-backlog-list-bounded-output
title: Bound swarm-manager backlog list output
